svg.font-family: Amazon Ember, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: CI/CD for AWS container services: application architecture on AWS. 1. Users reach the internet-facing Application Load Balancer over HTTP on port 80. 2. The ALB forwards to the task's IP on port 8080; the task's security group admits only the ALB's group. 3. The container sends its logs to CloudWatch Logs through the awslogs driver. 4. Fargate pulls the commit-SHA-tagged image from ECR. 5. The task execution role lets ECS pull that image and write the logs. The service places its one task in one of two public subnets, with a public IP and no NAT gateway. Security groups keep it reachable only from the ALB.
svg.text: Users reach the internet-facing Application Load Balancer over HTTP on port 80.
The ALB forwards to the task's IP on port 8080; the task's security group admits only the ALB's group.
The container sends its logs to CloudWatch Logs through the awslogs driver.
Fargate pulls the commit-SHA-tagged image from ECR.
The task execution role lets ECS pull that image and write the logs.
Dashed line: the execution role ECS uses for the task; the app itself has no IAM role.
The service places its one task in one of two public subnets, with a public IP and no NAT gateway.
Security groups keep it reachable only from the ALB.
